title: Job’s Righteousness and Trials

questions.question: Where did Job live?
questions.explanation: Job 1:1 (ESV): "There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job..."

questions.question: How many children did Job initially have?
questions.explanation: Job 1:2 (ESV): "There were born to him seven sons and three daughters."

questions.question: Who presented himself before the Lord alongside the sons of God?
questions.explanation: Job 1:6 (ESV): "Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came among them."

questions.question: What did God say there was no one like on earth?
questions.explanation: Job 1:8 (ESV): "...that there is none like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man, who fears God and turns away from evil?"

questions.question: What happened to Job's oxen and donkeys?
options: The Sabeans fell upon them and took them
questions.correctAnswer: The Sabeans fell upon them and took them
questions.explanation: Job 1:15 (ESV): "and the Sabeans fell upon them and took them and struck down the servants with the edge of the sword..."

questions.question: What disaster struck the sheep and servants?
options: The fire of God fell from heaven and burned them up
questions.correctAnswer: The fire of God fell from heaven and burned them up
questions.explanation: Job 1:16 (ESV): "...The fire of God fell from heaven and burned up the sheep and the servants and consumed them..."

questions.question: Who took the camels and killed the servants?
questions.explanation: Job 1:17 (ESV): "...The Chaldeans formed three groups and made a raid on the camels and took them..."

questions.question: How did Job's children die?
options: A great wind struck the house and it fell on them
questions.correctAnswer: A great wind struck the house and it fell on them
questions.explanation: Job 1:19 (ESV): "...and behold, a great wind came across the wilderness and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young people..."

questions.question: What was Job's reaction to all this bad news?
options: He tore his robe, shaved his head, and worshiped
questions.correctAnswer: He tore his robe, shaved his head, and worshiped
questions.explanation: Job 1:20 (ESV): "Then Job arose and tore his robe and shaved his head and fell on the ground and worshiped."

questions.question: What did Job say about his birth and death?
options: Naked I came from my mother's womb, and naked shall I return
questions.correctAnswer: Naked I came from my mother's womb, and naked shall I return
questions.explanation: Job 1:21 (ESV): "And he said, 'Naked I came from my mother's womb, and naked shall I return. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.'"

questions.question: Did Job charge God with wrong?
questions.explanation: Job 1:22 (ESV): "In all this Job did not sin or charge God with wrong."

questions.question: What reason did Satan suggest for Job's fear of God?
options: God had put a hedge around him and blessed him
questions.correctAnswer: God had put a hedge around him and blessed him
questions.explanation: Job 1:10 (ESV): "Have you not put a hedge around him and his house and all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands..."

questions.question: What limit did God place on Satan in the first trial?
options: Do not stretch out your hand against him (personally)
questions.correctAnswer: Do not stretch out your hand against him (personally)
questions.explanation: Job 1:12 (ESV): "...Behold, all that he has is in your hand. Only against him do not stretch out your hand..."

questions.question: What was Job doing when his children were feasting?
questions.explanation: Job 1:5 (ESV): "...Job would send and consecrate them, and would rise early in the morning and offer burnt offerings..."

questions.question: How many sheep did Job have?

key_verse_text: And he said, “Naked I came from my mother's womb, and naked shall I return. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.”
